name: foundationdb-dotnet-skills
description: Agent Skills for building correctly on the FoundationDB .NET client (FoundationDB.Client / SnowBank): key & value encoding, subspaces and the Directory layer, writing custom Layers, transactions and the retry loop, advanced/distributed patterns (change feeds, leases, retention, fencing), the Slice binary toolkit, the CrystalJson JSON stack and its source generator (the DOM, generated converters and proxies, self-serializable types, legacy DataContract interop), running/connecting to a cluster (the .NET Aspire hosting & client integrations and the native libfdb_c client), outbound HTTP with BetterHttpClient (DI policy bundles, TLS/certificates, porting legacy HttpWebRequest code), and writing/diagnosing multi-node integration tests on the SnowBank distributed-test framework (the unified test journal), plus argument guards and assertions with Contract (Contract.NotNull / Positive / Debug.Requires).
